claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 makes listed allergens mandatory information and requires upstream food businesses to provide sufficient downstream information.
The Commission's RASFF enables authorities to exchange food-chain health-risk information rapidly and can lead to market recalls.

contrary_evidence: Large manufacturers already operate mature product-lifecycle and supplier-quality systems.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through ingredient distributors, certification auditors, and laboratory networks.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 600 sites at 1200 PLN blended monthly revenue creates 8.6 million PLN ARR by year five and majority founder equity well above 5 million PLN without treating retained earnings as distributions.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3 founder hours daily for graph logic and partner operations while food-safety experts review exceptions.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75-85% gross margin after parsing, human exception review, and distributor revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 10000 PLN distributor connector pays back in six months with 30 active sites.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 390 PLN per assessed specification change plus 990 PLN monthly per manufacturing site.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every supplier, formulation, allergen, or label change triggers another paid impact assessment.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Contracted anonymized rights to change decisions, false positives, remediation, and recall links improve prioritization
fingerprint.customer: Small and mid-sized EU food manufacturers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded alerting through ingredient distributors and certification auditors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Ingredient-to-label dependency graph sold per change and per-site subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays when a change-impact report is cleared for release
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An ingredient supplier changes a composition, process, allergen declaration, or source

founder_fit: Document parsing and dependency modeling suit AI leverage and a low-social-energy channel strategy.
risks: A missed allergen change can harm consumers, so the tool must preserve qualified human release approval and complete audit trails.

structure.control_point: The dependency graph from supplier specification to recipe, label, and release approval
structure.critical_dependency: Structured bills of material and timely supplier-specification feeds

thesis: Embed a supplier-specification change graph with ingredient distributors and food auditors, charging whenever a change propagates to a recipe or label while accumulating permissioned remediation and incident links.
title: AllergenChange Supplier Graph
uncertainties: Supplier document variability and contractual data rights may prevent reliable automated propagation.
